evidence.s1_ci: ci.yml runs real scripts in site/ (npm ci, npm test with pretest prepare-data, npm run build = prepare-data+svelte-check+vite build; all exist in site/package.json) on pull_request plus actionlint; permissions contents: read; pages.yml build contents: read, deploy job pages: write/id-token: write; release.yml contents: write; only github.token; no pull_request_target; nothing run or published. But every action is referenced by tag, not SHA (step1.patch:55-56,104-105,113-114,129,154,174: checkout@v7, setup-node@v7, configure-pages@v6, upload-pages-artifact@v5, deploy-pages@v5), actionlint docker image by tag only, and pages.yml adds workflow_dispatch (step1.patch:84) without a branch guard, so a deploy from a non-main branch is possible. PAGES_BASE matches site/vite.config.ts:11.
evidence.s1_readme: README (step1.patch:284-361) covers requirements, install (cd site; npm ci), develop (npm run dev), test, build/preview, a table of index/fieldsets/prepare-data/sample-bullets, data contribution via the existing ISSUE_TEMPLATE files and PRs with sources, generated files ignored (matches site/.gitignore), CI/deploy, and MIT license with LICENSE and THIRD-PARTY.md present. Every command exists in site/package.json.
evidence.s1_release: CONTRIBUTING.md: version in site/package.json (already 0.1.0), SemVer mapping to records/features, release steps (changelog rename, npm version --no-git-tag-version, chore(release) commit, vX.Y.Z tag) implemented by release.yml (tag==version, tag on main, changelog section required, notes from changelog). CHANGELOG states Keep a Changelog 1.1.0. Dependabot npm (/site, grouped minor/patch) and github-actions, prefixes build/ci with scope matching the stated convention. Conventional Commits stated; all 7 commits conform. Minor: 43b029f 'build(deps): update npm packages and actions with Dependabot' describes package updates that the commit does not make (it only adds dependabot.yml).
evidence.s2_requirements: Route parse/href for #/compare/<a>/<b> with decodeURIComponent and fallback (router.ts patch); App.svelte lazy chunk; SVG role=img aria-label 'Profiles of {a} and {b}' with one <path> per case (Compare.svelte:390-401); caption Dimensions (mm)/(in) by unitSystem(); headers Symbol, name A, name B, Difference; symbols via FIELD_LABELS; Tol and FIELD_UNITS fields excluded, cartridge part only; difference b-a; metric formatValue, imperial displayNumber(...,'in'); Cartridge.svelte select labelled 'Compare with' listing other entries by name and 'Compare' button to href.compare(key, other); German strings in de; changelog entry; tests; commit e3d427f.
evidence.s2_correctness: Metric difference is formatValue(row.b - row.a) = String(float subtraction) (compare.ts formatDimension), so on #/compare/308_win/300_win_mag L1 shows 16.160000000000004 instead of 16.16, and similar noise on most rows; the test asserts String(13.03 - 12.01) i.e. 1.0199999999999996 (compare.test.ts). Imperial is clean thanks to toPrecision(12). Overlay is correct: viewportFor([pa,pb]) in upright frame maps z=0 (head face) to the same y and r=0 to a shared centre axis at PX_PER_MM (lib/geom/svg.ts:66-71); shot cartridges return null with a message; unknown keys show an error.
evidence.s2_fit: Reuses FIELD_LABELS/FIELD_UNITS/GROUP_ORDER/orderedFields/formatValue/PX_PER_MM from lib/core, viewportFor/fullSectionPath from lib/geom, adaptMetallic/caseOuterProfile from lib/shapes2d, displayNumber from units.ts, PageHeader, NativeSelect, Label, ShadcnButton; logic in site/src/lib/compare.ts with a sibling test like other modules; minimal touched files (App, router, metadata, nav, i18n, Cartridge). Minor: record as unknown as CartridgeRecord cast, broad try/catch to null, ad-hoc Tailwind table rather than existing table styles.
evidence.s2_tests: compare.test.ts tests row selection with real 308/300WM records, exclusion of Tol/angles/pressures/chamber, de-duplication, metric/imperial formatting and sign, head faces level via path coordinates, shotshell null; router.test.ts adds parse/round-trip/malformed cases. Uses repo's Vitest setup and @lib/testing/fixtures. No coverage of captions/accessible names/select (repo has no component tests), and the metric difference test enshrines the float-noise output.
evidence.s3_fixes: Bug: groupsOf now unions both records' groups, orderedFields over {...right, ...left}, DimensionRow a/b optional, rows kept when either side has a number; formatDimension returns '' for missing cells and difference (step3.patch:90-134); tests for delta L (A only) and R3 (B only). Style: text-right added to the two cartridge and Difference th and td (step3.patch:207-222), matching GroupTable's right-aligned num cells. Related text updates (lede, empty state, changelog wording) and rename sharedDimensions->dimensionRows; no unrelated changes.
evidence.cross_step: Step 2 added a line under [Unreleased]/Added; step 3 adjusted that unreleased entry, appropriate since the feature is unreleased; no version bump, consistent with the stated release-time bumping. Commits e3d427f feat: and 3810bc3 fix: follow Conventional Commits, but 3810bc3's subject omits the alignment change it also contains. Code appears type-correct for svelte-check (de typed as Record<keyof typeof en,string> and keys added to both) and tests would pass as written.

unmet_requirements: Step 1 (review criterion): GitHub Actions in ci.yml, pages.yml and release.yml are pinned to version tags, not full commit SHAs
Step 1 (review criterion): pages.yml can be dispatched manually from any branch (workflow_dispatch without a main-only guard)
Step 2 (correctness): metric Difference cells show floating-point noise (e.g. 16.160000000000004 for L1) instead of the exact difference
strengths: Complete, consistent release setup: Keep a Changelog, SemVer mapped to the project, a tag-triggered release workflow that checks tag/version/main/changelog, Dependabot whose commit prefixes match the stated Conventional Commits convention, and an accurate README
Compare view meets every stated requirement and reuses lib/core, lib/geom, lib/shapes2d, units.ts and site components, with logic kept in a tested framework-free module
Step 3 fixes both review points precisely (union of dimensions with empty cells and Difference; right-aligned value columns and headers) with focused tests
issues: Metric differences are String(b - a) and show floating-point noise on the example route (L1 16.160000000000004), and the unit test asserts that noisy output
None of the workflow actions are pinned to full commit SHAs (checkout@v7, setup-node@v7, configure-pages@v6, upload-pages-artifact@v5, deploy-pages@v5; actionlint image by tag)
pages.yml allows workflow_dispatch from any branch; commit subjects are partly inaccurate (43b029f claims package updates, 3810bc3 omits the alignment change)
review.verdict: The setup, the compare feature and the review fixes are well structured, reuse the repository's modules, and follow the stated changelog and commit conventions. Before merging, pin the actions to commit SHAs and compute metric differences without floating-point noise.
